claims.quoted_text: Therefore, the points to consider are \((\pm \sqrt{5}, \pm 2\sqrt{5})\).
claims.explanation: From \(y=2x\), the signs of \(x\) and \(y\) must agree. The actual points on the hyperbola are \((\sqrt{5},2\sqrt{5})\) and \((-\sqrt{5},-2\sqrt{5})\), not all four combinations implied by independent \(\pm\) signs.
